policy: Extract separate fixed observations from the48 validated full ports: geometric facet support, named five-reference map, role assignment, eligible-face domain, reader window/context and provenance. Enumerate equality of these observations on the576 same-face pairs. For the selected four-facet diagram, use the shared geometric edge as the invariant, not equality of the distinct parent facets.
kernel_instance: Choose two actual same-face records with different roles and named references. A Bool index selects the retained records. Its swap preserves their geometry observation and is admitted by the generic observed-equivalence gate. A claimed named-reference equality is rejected. This is a finite record-index reindexing, not an operational role transition or full packet-string equivalence.
boundary: An observation equality is not a law-domain transport witness. Full references and provenance may require explicit transport rather than equality; changing role labels must not be frozen by fiat. Geometry-only admissibility is intentionally weaker than source-semantic admission.
stop_condition: Exact source-bound component audit, all selected edge-support checks and fresh safe Cubical positive/hostile gates.
